outcomes: LO4 regionally important grapes and terms

scope_sources.outcome: Unit 1 LO2, still wine regional contexts and labelling

coverage_claim: Original, cited explanatory study content for named New World still-wine contexts. Includes only enumerated evidence and selected lower-level mappings. This is not official WSET endorsement, expert verification, exam content, or a complete qualification. Sparkling, fortified, practical tasting and global production/commerce remain separate audited dimensions.
source_semantics: Official WSET publications define study scope. Regional boards, regulators and technical sources support factual lesson claims. Promotional quality rankings, transient statistics, soil-to-flavour guarantees and required price ladders are excluded.
study_inheritance: L2 core items are inherited by L3 and L4. Reused L2 mappings are selected original beginner-suitable explanations only. Existing L3/L4 mappings are retained.
